name: xoga747-fix-china-embed-sheets-dev
description: China Vol - Options pipeline config: set workflowConfig.output.options.embedIntermediateSheets to false so the Actual Vol workbook has one sheet, as legacy MATLAB. Needs the bulk-uploader build with the SinkManager option (branch XOGA-747-china-extra-sheet).

steps.where: code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND template_name = 'China Vol - Options' AND tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113'

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE {{where}} AND rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,output,options,embedIntermediateSheets}' IS NULL AND jsonb_array_length(coalesce(rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,additionalOutputs}', '[]'::jsonb)) = 0
preconditions.reason: the config is still single-output and the flag is not set yet
